title: CONTINUITY: Security-Context Contracts for Composable LLM Agent Controls
abstract: arXiv:2609.05269v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM agent systems increasingly combine provenance tracking, authorization, policy enforcement, protocol adapters, and execution controls. However, individually correct security mechanisms do not necessarily compose into an end-to-end secure system: security-critical context may be dropped, widened, rebound, or reinterpreted as actions cross component boundaries. We identify this failure mode as security-context discontinuity and introduce CONTINUITY, a framework for verifiable composition of agent security controls.   CONTINUITY models each component with an assume-guarantee contract and carries authenticated security context across transitions using signed root grants, provenance commitments, role-bound transition receipts, bounded typed releases, transformation witnesses, and effect-bound execution permits. We formalize end-to-end consequence integrity, requiring every realized external effect to be backed by a valid and current auth

translated_title: CONTINUITY：面向可组合 LLM 智能体控制的安全上下文契约
translated_abstract: LLM 智能体系统日益将来源追踪、授权、策略执行、协议适配器和执行控制等多种机制组合在一起。然而，各自正确的安全机制并不必然能组合成一个端到端安全的系统：当操作跨越组件边界时，安全关键上下文可能被丢弃、放宽、重绑定或被重新解释。我们将这种失效模式识别为安全上下文不连续性，并引入 CONTINUITY——一个用于可验证组合智能体安全控制的框架。CONTINUITY 使用假设-保证契约对每个组件进行建模，并通过签名的根授权、来源承诺、角色绑定的转换回执、有界类型化释放、转换见证以及效果绑定的执行许可，在转换过程中携带经过认证的安全上下文。我们形式化了端到端结果完整性，要求每一个已实现的外部效果都必须由有效且当前有效的授权所支撑。
tldr: 该论文提出 CONTINUITY 框架，通过假设-保证契约和签名安全上下文传递机制（如根授权、来源承诺、转换回执等）解决 LLM 智能体安全组件组合时的“安全上下文不连续性”问题，并形式化端到端结果完整性以保证所有外部效果均有有效授权支撑。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces CONTINUITY, a framework that models agent security components with assume-guarantee contracts and carries authenticated security context (signed root grants, provenance commitments, transition receipts, etc.) across component boundaries, addressing security-context discontinuity and formalizing end-to-end consequence integrity to ensure every external effect is backed by valid and current authorization.
